scope: User selected Flash accounting and an official compression pilot, continuing the project retrospective. Three opaque, unrotated hour images only. No device window or firmware transfer.
capability_choice: Pinned SDK official ezip.exe plus Env.ImgResource; existing SF32LB52 EPIC/EZIP decoder. No hardware algorithm replaced. Fonts, rotating compass pointer and partition layout unchanged.

source_inspection.review: Read-only Sol/medium reviewed the official route, accounting and final integration. Luna/low checked three-image usage/rotation. Primary owns all writes, builds, Git and acceptance.
source_inspection.incremental_fix: Explicit Env.Value(ezip_flags) dependency added because the official Python Action does not declare FLAGS as a varlist. Preprocessor script and exported C are explicit File inputs. Incremental parameter mutation was not separately executed.
source_inspection.generated_identity: Official XML, original PNG and generated C remain intact. Temporary PNG only repacks exported RGB565 pixels; official SDK generates compressed C with the same descriptor symbol. Device SCons replaces three raw objects; host/editor keep originals.
source_inspection.payload_match: Independent read-only comparison confirmed three built compressed payloads equal offline roundtrip payloads byte-for-byte.

host_checks.coverage: LMA vs runtime address; discarded/merged sections excluded; overlapping UI sections rejected; RGB565/stride/length guard rejects invalid preprocessing. Actual PNG/EZIP roundtrip separately validates pixel correctness.

supplemental_build_input.note: Build.ps1 project-source list does not include scripts. Both ZIPs also preserve this preprocessor, probe/audit utilities, host test and result.json.

failures_and_limits: Strict baseline check initially rejected Git CRLF changes; original complete source ZIP proved only three listed line-ending differences.

Initial ezip calls with slash-separated paths returned 0 without output. Preserve logs under artifacts/flash-ezip-pilot-20261027; use native paths, per-file success marker, output and decoded-pixel checks.

Direct source-PNG conversion changed RGB565 quantization boundary pixels relative to the official XML export. Preserve existing exported pixels through a temporary RGB PNG; no XML or generated C was edited.
roundtrip-v1/v2 failures preserved; final roundtrip-v4 passed all three images. Tool success summary can report convert_num 0, so it is not the sole success oracle.
Product 20261027-194955-729 failed because the preprocessor relative path resolved through the variant. Absolute source File dependencies fixed it before successful dual builds.
Existing FinSH function-cast, linker RWX/syscall/ftab-entry warnings retained. No new image-compile warning observed.
No XML content changes or GUI re-export, no SDK/toolchain/partition/public Build entry change, no cloud baseline, no serial/flash/reset/RTC/PM operation.
No hardware display, source switching, wake restoration, frame time, runtime memory peaks, power or battery-life claim. Do not extrapolate the three-image ratio to fonts or the full firmware.
next_bounded_experiment: Prepare a three-image bounded display acceptance entry that does not change RTC or persisted settings; then separately bind an operator-confirmed device window and exact firmware, checking actual EPIC rendering, source switches/wake restoration and refresh cost before expanding compression.
